violations.description: Inadequate documentation in README file missing project details, setup, and usage instructions
violations.evidence: README file contains only 'Hello World!' and lacks markdown formatting extension (.md)
violations.recommendation: Rename to README.md and add detailed documentation including project overview, setup, and usage instructions

violations.description: Missing .gitignore file to prevent unintended tracking of temporary files or build artifacts
violations.evidence: No .gitignore file exists in the repository root
violations.recommendation: Add a .gitignore file configured for the project environment and development tools

violations.description: Missing test suite or tests directory
violations.evidence: No unit tests, integration tests, or test configurations were found in the repository
violations.recommendation: Implement an automated test suite and test runner configuration

violations.description: Missing automated CI verification for pull requests and pushes
violations.evidence: No .github/workflows directory or CI workflow configurations exist in the repository
violations.recommendation: Create a GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows to automate testing and build checks on PRs and pushes

violations.description: Missing contribution guidance and issue templates
violations.evidence: No CONTRIBUTING.md file or .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE directory found in the repository
violations.recommendation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md and issue templates to guide community contributions and bug reporting
